lisette.style: Time each bow draw, pin foes to walls with Heavy Shots, and watch hurt rivals through cover.

kit.name: Longbow
kit.line: Draw and loose. Let go on the flash for a faster draw.

kit.name: Hawk Sense
kit.line: Rivals under half health show through cover.

kit.name: Spirit Walk
kit.line: Roll, then walk through rocks and walls.

kit.name: Heavy Shot
kit.line: A heavy arrow that pins foes to walls.

kit.name: Hail Wall
kit.line: Rain a wall of arrows that slows and burns.

kit.name: Starpiercer
kit.line: Three big piercing arrows, no draw needed.

cinder.style: Soak foes in fire until they blaze, then finish them in the flames.

kit.name: Torch Lance
kit.line: Pour fire from your hand 7m ahead.

kit.name: Flashover
kit.line: Your fire sets foes Ablaze, then Flashes them over.

kit.name: Soot Ram
kit.line: Ram head first into the first foe.

kit.name: Cinder Shot
kit.line: A cinder that slows and spreads the burn.

kit.name: Furnace Cloak
kit.line: A heat blast drags foes in and shields you.

kit.name: Flue Flight
kit.line: Fly, laying a burning lava carpet.

breaker.style: Block with your aegis, then knock foes into walls with your hammer to stun them.

kit.name: War Hammer & Aegis
kit.line: Throw your hammer and call it back, or spin and slam.

kit.name: Guard
kit.line: Knock a foe into a wall or another foe to stun it.

kit.name: 360 Smash
kit.line: A short dash that ends in a spinning smash.

kit.name: Aegis
kit.line: Raise your aegis and block shots from the front.

kit.name: Mending Ground
kit.line: Call down a healing zone that ends in a burst.

kit.name: Faultline
kit.line: Slam the ground and throw every foe in a lane up.

tarek.style: Raises rocks to climb and hide behind, then punches them into the enemy.

kit.name: Rubble Fists
kit.line: Throw a boulder, or punch every rock in a lane.

kit.name: Molten Guard
kit.line: Punch your own rocks for a shield.

kit.name: Rock Hop
kit.line: Hop from rock to rock, up to three times.

kit.name: Quakefall
kit.line: Slam the ground ahead. The centre stuns.

kit.name: Stone Row
kit.line: Raise three rocks to climb, hide behind or punch.

kit.name: Basalt Spine
kit.line: Raise a long ridge of rocks, even over the abyss.

grimble.style: Hook a foe to your feet, smash them, finish them up close.

kit.name: Shotgun
kit.line: Seven slugs in a tight fan. Hits from behind hurt more.

kit.name: Salvage
kit.line: Knocks and assists stack extra health.

kit.name: Barge
kit.line: A low lunge, or a pounce in the air.

kit.name: Abyssal Hand
kit.line: Reach through rock, grab a foe and reel them in, stunned.

kit.name: Anchor Drop
kit.line: Slam your fist down for a long stun.

kit.name: Brass Broadside
kit.line: Two waves of brass slugs that block healing.

vex.style: Daze a foe with your Burr Charge, then shred them while it lasts.

kit.name: Quill Rifle
kit.line: Full-auto rifle. Dazed foes take 90% more.

kit.name: Hot Streak
kit.line: Knock a Hunter down and Slipstep comes back.

kit.name: Slipstep
kit.line: Skid or slide, and keep shooting.

kit.name: Burr Charge
kit.line: Fire the charge from your cannon; its blast Dazes.

kit.name: Longneedle
kit.line: Stand still, then fire a beam through walls.

kit.name: Cinderfall
kit.line: Call a burning shell down on the cursor.

kael.style: Get in, chain them close, and finish the wounded.

kit.name: Greatsword
kit.line: Wide greatsword slashes.

kit.name: Rage
kit.line: Fill Rage to Enrage: more damage, faster cooldowns.

kit.name: Rampage
kit.line: Charge through foes; the tip hits hardest.

kit.name: Smash
kit.line: A heavy slam. Hold to charge it.

kit.name: Warchain
kit.line: Chain a foe or a wall, then haul yourself in.

kit.name: Gilded Riposte
kit.line: Guard, then lunge into a healing cleave.

ryzz.style: Charge one foe to 4 Static, then Wirerun through them.

kit.name: Coilcaster
kit.line: Finger bolts to full range. Each adds Static.

kit.name: Static
kit.line: A fourth Static calls down a sky bolt.

kit.name: Wirerun
kit.line: Zap, or charge a long lane and streak through.

kit.name: Storm Rod
kit.line: Throw a copper rod that knocks back and stuns on walls.

kit.name: Skycall
kit.line: Drop a circle. Lightning drags everyone inside.

kit.name: Kitefall
kit.line: Launch up, then strike down anywhere in a wide ring.

motley.style: Stuns from range, drops a growing bomb on the stunned, and trades places to set it up.

kit.name: Tether Lantern
kit.line: Orbs through walls. Wait longer for a bigger one.

kit.name: Swell
kit.line: Fill Swell and everything you do grows.

kit.name: Lantern Trade
kit.line: Lob a lantern and swap places with everyone it lands on.

kit.name: Shard Snap
kit.line: Shards that stun, longer the further they flew.

kit.name: Brimseed
kit.line: A bomb that grows until you pop it.

kit.name: Nightwell
kit.line: Open a well that stuns and draws everything in.

claire.style: Homing darts, a freezing spear and a sliding ice wall.

kit.name: Hoar Fan
kit.line: A barrage of darts that curve onto your target.

kit.name: Hoarfrost
kit.line: Chill a foe enough and they Shatter.

kit.name: Skate
kit.line: Skate where you move. Your darts fly straight.

kit.name: Ice Spear
kit.line: An ice spear that slows, then bursts.

kit.name: Rink Wall
kit.line: Slide an ice wall forward, then freeze it.

kit.name: Rimelock
kit.line: Seal yourself in ice, then crack out and stun everyone near.

pip.style: Heals and carries the downed, roots whoever chases them.

kit.name: Ember Cast
kit.line: Embers from both hands mark foes.

kit.name: Carrier
kit.line: Run into downed teammates to carry them.

kit.name: Relay Step
kit.line: A quick hop, a long glide in the air.

kit.name: Burrseed
kit.line: A seed that roots its target.

kit.name: Hearthlight
kit.line: A healing ring for you and your team.

kit.name: Hearth Call
kit.line: Tether a teammate and heal them as you go.

sable.style: Stay on one foe, cartwheel, and land the big shot.

kit.name: Arc Shots
kit.line: Bolts from alternating hands that land at the cursor.

kit.name: Marks
kit.line: Every hit on the same foe adds a Mark: +10% damage.

kit.name: Vault
kit.line: Cartwheel. Your next shot hits big.

kit.name: Bola
kit.line: A bola that slows, and stuns two foes it ties.

kit.name: Shadow Knife
kit.line: Throw a dagger, then blink to it.

kit.name: Encore
kit.line: Blades fly at every foe in a ring around you.

gill.style: Throw whatever vial comes out of the bag, stack different effects to Beach your foes, then spin up a waterspout.

kit.name: Fencer
kit.line: Two quick thrusts with the swordfish, then a lunge that pierces and slows.

kit.name: Fish Out of Water
kit.line: Hit a foe with three different vials and they're Beached: a short stun.

kit.name: Ground Swim
kit.line: Swim through the ground. Surface next to foes to knock them up.

kit.name: Grab Bag
kit.line: Throw the vial in your hand: thunder, slime, air, fire, or a rare Super Zeep.

kit.name: Riptide
kit.line: Spin with the swordfish, then send a waterspout down a line.

kit.name: Tidal Wave
kit.line: Surf a wave of fish that knocks up and slows everything in its path.
